crime: For weeks, {WITCH_NAME} and her closest friend played cards as partners after lunch. {WITCH_NAME} tapped her fingers to signal the suit she was protecting, helping her friend win; the friend gained a reliable partner, and {WITCH_NAME} kept the same girl beside her. Before their final hand one afternoon, the friend gave the private signal to the opposing pair, played the card that won for them, moved her chair to their side, and agreed to join them that evening.
{WITCH_NAME} asked her friend to talk at the lake. The opposing pair saw them leave together and expected the friend back that evening.

At the water's edge, {WITCH_NAME} touched her friend's wrist and a loose, heavy stone, then joined them with her magic. She rolled the stone into the lake and shoved her friend after it. The stone sank beyond standing depth and held the joined wrist underwater until her friend drowned.

{WITCH_NAME} returned alone, saying her friend had stayed at the lake. When the friend missed the evening game, the opposing pair searched and found the body below the surface near shore. One wrist appeared caught beneath the stone, so they first thought the friend had slipped while moving it.

Several girls pulled the body toward shore, and the stone moved with the wrist although no cloth, cord, or fastener joined them. Touch Join was still holding them together, which meant {WITCH_NAME} had touched both the dead girl and the stone. The free hand clutched a strip matching a fresh tear in the witch's distinctive prison shirt. The opposing pair had seen the betrayal, watched the two friends leave together, and seen the witch return alone. The magical join and the cloth refuted the witch's claim that they had parted at the lake.
fields.epitaph: She could join anything she touched. Her partner still crossed the table.
execution: An iron rack holds her faceup, with broad straps around her forearms and ankles. Her arms are already spread.

The rack's four ends slide outward without stopping. The straps pull her wrists and ankles apart, then tear her shoulders and hips as they draw every limb away from her center. The rack keeps opening until her torso splits and her chest stops moving. Her body remains stretched across it.

magic.name: Touch Join
magic.text: She can join two things she touches without glue, rope, or any other fastener.
